content.title: ClickHouse valued at $15 billion as database analytics firm rides AI wave
content.summary: Database management company ClickHouse was valued at $15 billion in its latest funding round, CEO Aaron ​Katz said on Friday, as investor enthusiasm for companies related ‌to the artificial intelligence boom spills over into the new year. The firm raised $400 million in ‌a series D round led by Dragoneer Investment Group with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, GIC and Index Ventures, among others. In the race to deploy AI tools, companies covet real-time analytics software providers such as ClickHouse ⁠that help manage soaring data ‌volumes and performance needs.
